description: 1N914 small-signal silicon diode (our fit to Diotec's and onsemi's sheets: onsemi gives 1N914 and 1N4148 one die and one set of curves)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.if_avg: Diotec 1N4148, 1N4150, 1N4151, 1N4448 data sheet, Version 2023-08-17: Max. average forward current IFAV 200 mA (1N4148)
rating_sources.vr_max: Diotec 1N4148, 1N4150, 1N4151, 1N4448 data sheet, Version 2023-08-17: Reverse voltage VR 75 V (1N4148)

fit.figure: Forward characteristics (typical values), Tj = 25 °C, from 2.4 mA (read from the PDF's vector drawing, centre of the drawn line)
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point, the curve's last point always included; Below 2.4 mA, three points of onsemi 1N91x/1N4x48 data sheet, 1N914/D Rev. 6 (Sep 2024), Figures 3 and 4 (10 µA, 100 µA, 1 mA; read off the images, confirmed by the user on 2026-10-20) are fitted with the curve; CJO is the sheets' 4 pF at 0 V; BV 100 V at 100 µA, onsemi's breakdown test
fit.note: Two makers' typical curves for one part: Diotec's from 2.4 mA, onsemi's below. Fitted alone, Diotec's curve reads 35-49 mV low at onsemi's points; together every point lands within 14 mV, close to onsemi's own card (IS 2.5 nA, N 1.75)
